subject: Catalyst Tech vendor onboarding - invoice timing & early-pay options
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@catalyst-tech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Catalyst Tech vendor onboarding - invoice timing & early-pay options

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking this — I manage vendor ops at Catalyst Tech. We're starting the Redwood evaluation next week and want to get vendor onboarding complete so POs can be issued and our first invoice isn't delayed. A few items for your team:

- Preferred payment terms: Net 45 is fine, but we prefer Net 30 where possible.
- We can offer a 1% discount if Redwood is able to pay Net 15 via ACH.
- Attached: W-9 and our vendor onboarding packet (PDF).

Can you confirm what forms you need in your procurement flow, approximate time to PO activation, and whether there is an early-pay program we should apply for? If helpful, I can route any bank verification docs right away.

Best,
Emma Lopez
Vendor Operations
Catalyst Tech
attachments: catalyst_w9.pdf, catalyst_onboarding_packet.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@catalyst-tech.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Catalyst Tech vendor onboarding - invoice timing & early-pay options

Thanks Emma — welcome.

Quick checklist from our side (vendor intake):
1) Completed vendor onboarding form (please see the attached version and fill the highlighted fields)
2) Legal name + EIN (we have W-9 but need the exact payee name as shown on invoices)
3) Remittance instructions (ACH details or remit-to address)
4) Billing contact and PO routing preference (email + any special PO header requirements)

Our standard onboarding-to-PO window is typically 3–5 business days once we have completed paperwork and bank verification. Standard finance policy is Net 45 for new vendors unless finance approves accelerated terms. David — looping you in to confirm whether we can consider Net 30 or an early-pay discount pilot here. Marissa — this is the vendor for the upcoming evaluation; wanted you on the thread for any commercial levers.

I've attached our vendor intake form for completion. If you can return the filled form plus a voided check or ACH verification, I'll kick off the PO activation.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_blank.pdf

- Remit via ACH to account on voided check; for invoices, please include PO number and bill to: 200 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Billing contact: Emma Lopez (emma@catalyst-tech.com, +1 415-555-0198)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Emma Lopez <emma@catalyst-tech.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Catalyst Tech vendor onboarding - invoice timing & early-pay options

Hi all — reviewed the completed intake. A couple of items and an offer for a short pilot:

1) Standard approval: We default to Net 45 for new vendors to align cash forecast. We can make an exception to Net 30 at the procurement manager's discretion; Priyom, please confirm if you want to proceed with Net 30.
2) Early-pay pilot: Finance is open to a 90-day early-pay pilot for strategic vendors: 1% discount for Net 15 ACH in exchange for guaranteed settlement. We need vendor to complete ACH enrollment & bank verification prior to activation.
3) Risk checks: For any accelerated terms we require basic vendor validation (EIN match & voided check) and an ML-based vendor-risk score. If the vendor passes, David (Finance) can provision early-pay.

Action items:
- Priyom: confirm term (Net 45 default vs Net 30 requested).
- Emma: confirm you'll complete the ACH enrollment via DocuSign link and allow finance to run a quick vendor score.
- Marissa: if this is a sales-priority vendor, please confirm commercial rationale for early-pay pilot (expected spend velocity).

If all agree, Priyom will mark vendor as "Ready for PO" and we will target PO issuance within 2 business days.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: docusign_vendor_agreement_link.txt
